lines.en: I head to the park to hang out with Karin for a bit.
lines.zh: 我去公园陪 Karin 待了一会儿。

lines.en: She spends the first half hour running laps but eventually decides to take a break and talk to me instead.
lines.zh: 前半小时她都在跑圈，最后决定休息一下，过来跟我说话。

lines.en: The two of us discuss simple things like her favorite activities and what she wants to do when she's out of [high_school].
lines.zh: 我们聊了些简单的事，比如她最喜欢的活动，还有[高中]毕业以后想做什么。

lines.en: I'm not surprised to hear that she's basically got everything planned out already.
lines.zh: 听说她基本上已经把一切规划好了，我并不意外。

lines.en: Unlike her sister, Karin has a clear direction of where she wants to go in life. And I'm glad she's willing to share some of that with me.
lines.zh: 和她姐姐不同，Karin 对自己想走的路很清楚。我很高兴她愿意跟我分享一些。

lines.en: Karin hesitantly tells me that she needs to go as soon as the sun starts to set.
lines.zh: 太阳刚开始落，Karin 就犹犹豫豫地说她得走了。

lines.en: I feel slightly bad about taking up so much of her time, so I obviously tell her to go do whatever it is she needs to do and not let me stop her.
lines.zh: 占了她这么多时间，我有点过意不去，于是当然让她去做该做的事，别被我耽搁。

lines.en: She smiles as she leaves and nervously waves goodbye as she jogs off in the direction of her house.
lines.zh: 她笑着离开，紧张地挥了挥手，然后朝她家的方向小跑而去。

lines.en: I might be a little quick in saying this, but I think she's already starting to get a little more comfortable around me...
lines.zh: 这话也许说得早了点，但我觉得她在我身边已经开始放松一些了……
